description: This Java source file defines the S3StorageService class, an implementation of StorageService that interacts with Amazon S3 using the AWS SDK. It provides methods for storing, retrieving, checking, and deleting data in an S3 bucket, with configurations for credentials, region, endpoint, and multipart uploads.

classes.name: S3StorageService
classes.description: An implementation of StorageService that interacts with Amazon S3 for storing and retrieving data, leveraging asynchronous SDK clients for efficient file transfer.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves an object from S3 as InputStream based on the specified key.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Fetches metadata of the object stored at the specified key in S3.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Lists keys in the S3 bucket with given module or group and prefix.

methods.name: purgeData
methods.description: Deletes the object specified by key from S3 if it exists.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks whether an object with the given key exists in S3.

methods.name: saveData
methods.description: Uploads data from an InputStream to S3 with associated metadata.
